entry.name: urn
entry.description: Outputs random numbers and keeps track of each number that has been generated. When all numbers up to the maximum (set via an argument or the right inlet) have been output, a bang is send out the right outlet.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: The number of possible values for the random number generator. If no argument is typed in, there will be onlypossible number. The maximum limit is 4096.

arguments.name: seed
arguments.description: A second argument is used to set a "seed" value for the random generator. If no argument is specified, the time value will be used to initialize the seed.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: In left inlet: Sends out a previously unchosen random number from 0 to one less than the specified maximum limit.

messages.name: clear
messages.digest: Clear the list of output numbers
messages.description: In left inlet: Clears the list of already chosen numbers.

messages.name: in1
messages.description: Clears the list of already chosen numbers, and specifies the number of possible values for the random number generator. The random numbers will range from 0 to one less than this maximum limit. The maximum limit is 4096.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In right inlet: Clears the list of already chosen numbers, and specifies the number of possible values for the random number generator. The random numbers will range from 0 to one less than this maximum limit. The maximum limit is 4096.

messages.name: seed
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by a number, provides a "seed" value for the random generator, which causes a specific (reproducible) sequence of pseudo-random numbers to occur. The numberuses the time elapsed since system startup (an unpredictable value) as the seed, ensuring an unpredictable sequence of numbers. This unpredictable seed is used by default when theobject is created. However, once all numbers have been chosen, the sequence will repeat. Therefore, in order to achieve a non-repeating sequence of numbers, you will need to send theobject themessage each time you send it themessage.
